This is a nonpersonal services contract requesting software development of Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) interfaces for the Mission Termination System (MTS), yielding a Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product . MTS is a Run Time Assurance (RTA) tool based on the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) code base created by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Lab (JHU APL). MTS is used at Edwards AFB to safely test autonomous control of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein. Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the contractor who, in turn, is responsible to the government. 1.1.1 Description of Services/Objectives. Therefore, Crestron remains the only provider capable of meeting the technical and compatibility needs for this upgrade. 2. What is the impact to the government if another vendor/brand is used? Include any dollar, schedule, or compatibility impacts if possible. Utilizing a different vendor or brand could result in significant schedule delays, as the government would need to evaluate, integrate, and train personnel on unfamiliar equipment. Previous experience indicates that such processes can considerably slow project progress. Additionally, switching to an alternative brand may introduce compatibility issues with the existing Crestron-based infrastructure, necessitating further technical adjustments, extended testing, and new approval procedures before the system can operate correctly. These challenges are likely to increase costs, compromise reliability, and disrupt operational continuity, making alternative brands both time-consuming and financially burdensome for the government. deadline_authority.rule: Only dates locally attached to tender/bid/quotation submission or requests-to-participate language can automatically resolve bid timing. Query/clarification dates are never accepted as submission deadlines. Missing/ambiguous submission evidence remains review-required before FINAL_SUPER_GREEN.

items.review_contract: Gate-ready authoritative DCE evidence pack from the current DCE generation. Unknown is never PASS. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN requires every mandatory gate resolved and authoritative deadline reconciliation.

ranking_contract: Recall-first discovery; post-DCE SPM-fit reranking only. Approximately 80% priority lane + 20% evidence-quality exploration lane. No candidate is declared eligible by this rank.
